title: ଦେବୀ ପକ୍ଷ
excerpt:
ଯଦି କେବେ ମୃଦୁ ମଳୟ ସହିତ
ଆକାଶରୁ ଖସିବ ବଜ୍ର
ଭୁଇଁ ତଳୁ ଧସିଯିବ ମାଟି
ତୁ କିଛି ବୁଝିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ

title: ନୀରବତାର ଆର୍ତ୍ତନାଦ
excerpt:
ଏବେଠୁ ବାନ୍ଧିନେବି
ନୀରବତା ସହ ଅତୁଟ ବନ୍ଧନ,
ଅସୁମାରୀ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶାର
ସବୁ ମୋହ ତ୍ୟାଗି

title: ଜୁଆ
excerpt:
ଆଖି ଛୁଉଁଛି...
ସତ କହୁଛି...
ତୁମକୁ ସାକ୍ଷୀ ରଖି
ଲଗାଇଲି ବାଜି---

title: हरश्रृंगार धरा पर बिखर गई
excerpt:
हरश्रृंगार धरा पर बिखर गई.....
काश! कहीं कोई ऐसा हो,
जो बनकर आधार सँभाले,
थककर जब यह जीवन बिखरे,

title: क्षणिका
excerpt:
गांव का सुनसान प्लेटफार्म,
बरसती बूँदों की छांव,
पटरी पर धीमे-धीमे
गुजरती ट्रेन की थरथर ध्वनि।

title: बचपन की याद
excerpt:
माँ का वो आगन
दिल रहता था कितना मगन
बचपन की वो कहानी
अब हो गई पुरानी……

title: No Love Poems Henceforth
excerpt:
No love poems, henceforth,
Nether I will write
Nor I will do read love poems any further
But it`s not easy for me

title: Where One Is Upto?
excerpt:
River water
In quest of a friendly estuary
Comes across
A mossy rock,

title: The Balidiah Dam
excerpt:
Under the high heaven in September
Hills are decorated with green attire,
Dewy, leafy banners
Sprightly move the tops

title: When the Stars Forget My Name
excerpt:
Sometimes I wonder how that day will be,
When these two feet no longer touch your ground,
When your bright eyes no longer look for me,
And I am nowhere left here to be found.

title: Gandhian Thought
excerpt:
I was fierce when I was young,
I would lose my temper over little things.
I was strongly built, too,
but words did not come easily to me.

title: It`s Atlas again
excerpt:
Dusk descends with chilling whisper,
Twilight brings the curtain down,
Restless ego fizzles and fizzles,
The gloom settles at downtown.

title: Eternal waiting
excerpt:
What a jolly mood of the fascinated bee that collects nectarean glee !
The reciprocating flowers hypnotized by their aerial love
Really a compromising canvas of love and beloved
Am often surprised , why this lunatic heart craves for an unknown one ?
